rule: Each cell is found by its Row ID and must still hold "old" before it is written (header cells: row 1). (1a) A new LAST column AA "Also Sold As" on MTH Tinplate and MTH O (both grids are 26 columns wide: one column is appended first). "Lionel Corporation" on every 11- row that MTH's own product page (Product Line "Lionel Corporation" / title "Lionel Corporation Tinplate") or the row's own Original Description proves, plus the American Flyer reproductions (Q1). Nothing on MTH-own-line rows (Tinplate Traditions / RailKing, Q10), unproven rows, or rows that Write 2 will delete. (1b) Gauge "O" + Track Power "3-Rail O" on MTH Tinplate rows that MTH's page Scale / title or the row's own words call O gauge (Q2). (1c) Gauge "Standard" on the MTH O rows MTH calls Std. Gauge (Q3). (1d) The 11 MTH Tinplate rows doubled on MTH O take MTH O's catalog values where they are missing or disagree (Description, Year as a plain year, Road Name, Original Description, Category, MSRP); Item Type unchanged (Q4). (1e/1f) Details only the Greenberg-book copies held go onto the kept MTH rows (both rows of a -0/-1 pair): Road Name and Year Produced only where blank; colour/trim words appended to the END of Variation Description (never MTH's Description); a Notes line "From the Greenberg book copy (...)" on each such row (Q5, Q8, decision 11). (1g) Lionel MPC-Modern Gauge "Standard" on Lionel's own Standard gauge rows: 21 whose prewar original is Standard on the Lionel Pre-War tab, 13103 (Trainz page), 13402/13412/13420 (Brad) (Q9). Row IDs, Item Numbers and every other cell unchanged. No row is added or deleted here; the row deletes are a later, separate fix (Write 2).
